question: Where can I find an attraction that fall within 50 kilometers in the northwest direction of Spella Park, Algonquin, IL?
sql: SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_city, P.addr_state FROM pois AS P WHERE P.tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_DWithin(P.geometry::geography, ( SELECT park_geom.geometry::geography FROM parks AS park_geom WHERE park_geom.park_name ILIKE '%Spella Park%' AND ST_Intersects(park_geom.geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Algonquin%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 )) LIMIT 1 ), 50000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ST_Centroid(( SELECT park_geom.geometry FROM parks AS park_geom WHERE park_geom.park_name ILIKE '%Spella Park%' AND ST_Intersects(park_geom.geometry, ( SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Algonquin%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1 )) LIMIT 1 )), ST_Centroid(P.geometry) )) BETWEEN 292.5 AND 337.5;
